results.releaseNotes: You deserve the best of Nike and Jordan - that includes the occasional update to keep things running smoothly. Most recent updates include improved experience shopping with AI product search, inspirational storytelling, product & athlete spotlights, and personalization.
results.description:
The Nike App is your personal guide to all things Nike. ​​Become a Member ​​​and​​ get​​ exclusive ​access ​to ​the latest from Nike and Jordan. Shop innovative sport styles, workout clothes, trending sneaker releases, and curated streetwear collections. Unlock ​​Member Rewards, personalized ​​style advice, and easy shipping and returns, all in one seamless shopping app.

SHOP BETTER AS A MEMBER
Free Shipping on Orders $50+, Member-only promotions, 60-day wear tests, and receiptless returns when you shop online through the app as a Nike Member.
• Member Profile: View Activity, orders, and purchase history. Buy apparel, sport styles, sneakers, and accessories with the Nike online shopping app.
• Member Rewards: Celebrate big moments like your birthday & Member anniversary.
• Shopping App Exclusives: Unlock exclusive sportswear and streetwear. Get first dibs on new releases dropping weekly. Shop Air Max Muse, Vomero 18, Nike Dunk, and Air Jordan. Explore our latest innovations in running shoes, training gear, gym clothes, and more.
• Jordan Mode: Shop the latest in Jordan clothing and sneakers, plus unlock exclusive content available only in Jordan Mode. Explore classic Jordans, streetwear, and the newest sneaker release.
• Jordan Sport: Find Jordan essentials from basketball shoes and football cleats to golf apparel.
• Nike By You: Shop and customize iconic Nike shoes with curated color palettes and premium materials that match your style.
• Nike Gift Cards: Buy digital and physical Nike Gift Cards for every athlete in your life. Unlock a world of footwear, equipment, and apparel.

SERVICES THAT CONNECT & GUIDE YOU
Shop online and in-store more easily with the Nike App. Turn on notifications to be the first to score the latest releases. Chat one-on-one with a Nike expert for style advice. Take advantage of app-only shopping tools when visiting a Nike store.
• Notifications: Never miss a sneaker drop. Shop online for the latest styles, athlete collaborations, events, and more by turning on push notifications.
• Easy In-Store Shopping: Scan product barcodes in-store to quickly retrieve product details, find additional colorways, and read reviews from fellow athletes.
• Training & Coaching for all: Expert advice delivered by Nike athletes, coaches, and personal trainers. Receive training tips from your Nike community wherever you are.
• Nike Experts: Get sport and style advice from our Nike experts. Whether you are shopping for trending streetwear, men's clothing, or kids' sneakers, buy apparel with expert assistance.
• Exclusive Nike Experiences: Find Member-only events in your city and attend IRL or online. Join your Nike community.
• Shop Online with Athlete Guidance: Get exclusive access to expert advice, personalized shopping recommendations, and Member-only perks.

STORIES THAT INSPIRE & INFORM YOU
In-depth stories spanning across sport and culture, delivered daily. Follow your favorite athletes, sports teams, and products.
• Member Home: Explore new, curated Nike stories, refreshed daily.
• New From Nike: Discover Sneakers of the Week, view the next sneaker release, and browse shopping collections for women's and men's clothing.
• Apparel & Sneaker Trends: Learn new ways to wear your favorite Nike styles, accessories, footwear, and streetwear.
• Sportswear Collections: Running shoes, sports accessories, or gym clothes—learn what gear empowers the top Nike athletes.

Shop with Member benefits and explore the latest from Nike and Jordan. Unlock exclusive apparel, style recommendations, in-person experiences, and the newest sneaker release. Buy shoes, trending apparel, and workout clothes tailored to your sport and style goals.

Download today and experience shopping as a Nike Member.

results.description:
Explore, buy, and unlock the best of Nike, Jordan, and Converse. SNKRS is more than a shoes shopping app - giving sneakerheads insider access to the latest launches featuring exclusive sneakers and streetwear apparel. 

SNKRS FEATURES

STAY A STEP AHEAD
* Shop sneakers and streetwear: Buy the latest sneaker styles and trending women’s and men’s clothing
* Set Notifications: Stay updated with the latest sneaker news, releases, and exclusive stories. View upcoming drops and prepare for the streetwear you want most – from the latest shoes to trending apparel.
* Reserve Sneakers with SNKRS Pass: Secure your pair with SNKRS and pick it up at your nearest shoe store for a seamless launch day experience
* Get Exclusive Access: Get rewarded with invite-only launches to some of the most coveted women’s and men’s clothing and sneaker styles.
* Catch Surprise Drops: Be ready for a range of unique launch scavenger hunts – access might be hidden in geo-located events, scannable augmented reality targets or scratch-able images

EXPLORE THE COMMUNITY
* View Exclusive SNKRS Stories: Learn about the inspiration and heritage behind your favorite streetwear styles and sneakers. Access untold tales from the SNKRS community
* Vote on Polls: Have your voice heard in the sneaker community by answering questions that inform everything from future products to experiences and content
* Watch SNKRS Live: Tune in for the latest sneaker news on exclusive collabs and upcoming releases. Catch SNKRS livestreams and join the conversation with live polling, never heard stories, the inside scoop, and more
* Discover SNKRS Maps: Whether you’re traveling to a new city or exploring your local neighborhood, SNKRS Maps is with you. Visit local sneaker stores, community spaces and events near you.

HOW TO GET STARTED
* Sign up or log in with your Nike account
* Save your correct name, size, and shipping address under your profile so you are ready for
launch day
* Start shopping and discover fresh streetwear apparel and sneakers

Join the community today.
